subject: Sponsor orbit & EB runbook for WaveTech close plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsor orbit & EB runbook for WaveTech close plan

Team — quick recap from this morning's WaveTech exec call and request to map sponsors + lock EB availability. Key points from discovery:
- WaveTech is evaluating Redwood for inference serving across two products (Realtime Search + Batch embeddings).
- Goal: pilot in Q3, procurement target end of June, exec sign-off by July 15.
- Primary champion: Alicia Ramos (VP Product). Procurement will engage after the EB.

Asks: 1) Confirm which execs we want on the EB (slot owners + alternates). I propose: Alicia to bring VP Product and CIO; we should bring an executive sponsor from Redwood (SVP Sales or CRO) + Solutions lead. 2) Draft a one-page EB runbook (roles, outcomes, success criteria, MAP milestones) and attach to the MAP. 3) Lock 2 candidate 90-minute EB slots (Americas-friendly) the week of May 17 and the week of May 24.

I've attached a blank MAP template and a starter EB agenda. I'll drop an edited version with sponsor names once we confirm.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: WaveTech_MAP_v1.xlsx, EB-Agenda_WaveTech_v0.3.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor orbit & EB runbook for WaveTech close plan

Thanks Vanessa — high level mapping and a few notes.

Sponsor mapping (proposed):
- Executive sponsor (Redwood): Marcus Lin (VP, Enterprise Sales) — primary
- Backup exec sponsor: Karthik Iyer (Head of Solutions) — will own technical escalation during EB
- Field sponsor / deal owner: Vanessa Ortiz — owns commercial commitments and MAP
- CS engagement lead (post-EB): Ben Carter — onboarding & pilot SOW owner

EB roles (draft):
- Redwood Exec sponsor (opening remarks, commitment level)
- Solutions deep-dive (45m): Karthik + engineering SEs
- Commercial & timeline (20m): Vanessa + Ben
- Procurement & next steps (15m): legal/ops touchpoints and action items

Timing: I blocked tentative slots: Tue May 18 13:00-14:30 PT and Wed May 26 10:00-11:30 PT. If Alicia prefers earlier in the week of the 17th, we can swap. I'll assemble the runbook doc; Vanessa — can you confirm Marcus availability for a 20-minute opening?

-Marissa
Director, Customer Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@wavetech.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-09T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed EB slots + draft runbook (WaveTech)

Alicia — great conversation this morning. Per our discussion, attaching a short EB runbook and the MAP template so we can align outcomes and next steps ahead of the exec briefing. Proposed 90-minute EB slots:
- Option A: Tue May 18, 13:00-14:30 PT
- Option B: Wed May 26, 10:00-11:30 PT

Purpose of EB: validate success criteria for pilot, confirm technical fit for Realtime Search, and nail procurement checkpoints so your team can present to legal and finance. Expected attendees from Redwood: Marcus Lin (exec sponsor – 20m opening), Karthik Iyer (solutions deep-dive), Vanessa Ortiz (commercial), Ben Carter (CS + pilot SOW).

Next steps: please confirm preferred slot and attendee list (including WaveTech execs you want in the room). I will finalize the runbook and MAP with dates and deliverables in the next 24 hours.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: EB-Agenda_WaveTech_v0.3.pdf, WaveTech_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@wavetech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Liu <david.liu@wavetech.com>, procurement@wavetech.com
Date: 2027-05-10T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed EB slots + draft runbook (WaveTech)

Vanessa — thanks, this is helpful. We can do Option A (Tue May 18 13:00-14:30 PT). Confirmed attendees from WaveTech: Alicia Ramos (VP Product), David Liu (CIO), and one of our ML platform leads — TBD. Procurement (procurement@wavetech.com) will join the call for the final 15 minutes to confirm purchasing timeline.

A couple quick asks:
- Please include success criteria in the MAP (performance SLA targets for latency and throughput) so procurement has concrete gating metrics.
- Can Marcus join live for the opening? If not, a short recorded message is acceptable.

Forwarding my calendar invite now.

Thanks — Alicia
VP Product, WaveTech

Subject: Re: Sponsor orbit & EB runbook for WaveTech close plan

Perfect — slot confirmed for May 18 13:00-14:30 PT. I attached a populated MAP (first pass) with timelines and proposed owners, and a redline SOW draft for the pilot. Highlights:
- Pilot workstream owners and dates (pilot kickoff June 7; evaluation window June 14-30)
- Procurement gating: draft purchase order & billing cadence to be ready by June 25
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 150ms for 1k qps steady-state (Realtime), embedding recall baseline + cost per 1M tokens target (we put placeholders)

Next actions: Vanessa — get Marcus on the 20-minute opening or record a short commitment. Marissa — I'll sync with you on the runbook handoff to CS.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
